title: Quarterly Roadmap: Private Deploy 'Experimentation Labs' and Hypothesis-Driven Rollouts
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Build a lightweight, hypothesis-driven roadmap track ("Experimentation Labs") for Private/VPC/on-prem features this quarter. The goal is to convert early enterprise pilot feedback into validated rollout patterns with clear gating criteria, instrumentation, and a small set of hardened playbooks. Workstreams include: 1) pilot cohort orchestration (customer selection, onboarding checklist), 2) telemetry and OKR-aligned signals for quality and cost, 3) canary gating and rollback playbooks for on-prem upgrades, and 4) developer/operator docs and runbooks for Tier-1 private customers. This ticket coordinates cross-functional planning, defines measurable experiments, and sequences deliverables to support the broader Private Deploy Experience initiative.
acceptance_criteria: Pilot plan documented and signed off with 2 anchor customers and associated SSO/KMS checklist
Telemetry dashboard surfacing 3 primary signals (latency P95, provisioning failure rate, model-compatibility regressions) with alert thresholds mapped to runbook actions
Canary rollout playbook validated in staging and an automated rollback path tested against a simulated version compatibility failure
Ops-runbook and onboarding checklist published in Confluence; two support engineers trained and able to execute a dry-run onboarding
updates: 2026-03-01 - Created ticket and initial scope draft. Identified need for hypothesis-driven approach rather than feature-batching.
2026-03-03 - Sync with Design (Ava Chen) on pilot onboarding UX; agreed to reduce onboarding steps to 6 core items and provide a one-click test harness for customers.
2026-03-05 - ENG kickoff: scoped integration work for KMS onboarding and initial telemetry hooks; estimated 6 dev points for baseline signals.
2026-03-09 - PM review: mapped experiments to OKRs and prioritized pilot customers (two anchor customers: FinMate and HealthLogic).
2026-03-12 - Security flagged a review for KMS/HSM integrations; security review requested and added as gating dependency.
2026-03-14 - Scoped additional observability work to capture model-version drift; dependency ENG-60211 added to track runtime metric export.
Next - Execute pilot onboarding for FinMate week of 2026-03-22 and validate telemetry thresholds by 2026-03-26.
okrs: O: Reduce time-to-onboard enterprise private deployments by 40% this quarter
KR1: Reduce average onboarding checklist completion time from 7 days to 4 days for pilot customers
KR2: Detect and auto-escalate 90% of model-compatibility regressions within 10 minutes via telemetry
KR3: Achieve successful canary rollouts for at least 2 production-like private instances with zero customer-facing downtime
